Definition: continued comparative of G3187; still larger (figuratively):--greater.
BiblicalUsage: Meizoteros is the stronger comparative, still greater, and John uses it once, in 3 John 1:4, where he says he has no greater joy than to hear that his children walk in truth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a pastor's greatest joy is not a growing church but children who keep walking in the truth.
